digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend facade and jira adapter
propositions: Reconciler core requires a backend facade interface to decouple from Jira adapter specifics and enable future multi-backend support
Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and RemoteRef dataclass must be defined as the backend contract
Three opt-in capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) are detected at runtime via isinstance checks, not structural introspection or capability query methods
JiraBackend thin wrapper must delegate to existing Jira modules with zero behavior change, requiring contract and characterization tests to prove delegation correctness
IdentityConvention pure object must encapsulate rebar-id label formatting/parsing previously inlined at four core call sites without rewiring those sites in this story
